original_reference: dz64 du2; independent standard Gaussian64 and Uniform[0,1]^2
material_loss: full-grid mean abs(complex error)^2; MAE=mean abs(complex error)
GT_processes: truth generation exits before inference starts; independent offline scoring after method freeze; no imports from offline arrays in online modules

baseline.selection: objective and stationarity, then paid RHS; no GT

development.selection: y-only anchor features: final Phi, saturation fraction, property-bound distance, log spectral condition; deterministic farthest-first after standardization, first parent DEV_000; never GT

reference.primary: fixed-preconditioned MALA on exact probit property coordinates
reference.coordinates: x=(z,eta),u=normal_CDF(eta); transformed density=exp(-Phi-.5 norm(x)^2), exact uniform-prior transport with Jacobian, not a Gaussian replacement in q
crosschecks: independent tempered SMC if primary fails
reference.qualification: all diagnostics plus independent-method agreement; never a global mixing proof

local_region.escape_mass: unknown without qualified independent FULL reference

gaussian_frame: orthogonal64, properties explicit; no Gaussian prior precision assigned to uniform coordinates
analytic_moments: exact for declared Gaussian field conditional with fixed explicit properties; not exact Maxwell posterior

independent_pool.locked_GT: not opened until model/rules frozen and outcomes persisted
independent_pool.locked_expansion_condition: development material-risk or credible UQ signal; otherwise report not run

learning.teacher_distillation: qualified independent posterior only; otherwise NOT_RUN
learning.joint_NLL: full weak marginal conditional on declared context, not LOCAL-C teacher

decision_order: probability reference -> conditional material imaging -> geometry/cost -> normalized learned density -> bandit/RL if reference/benefit supports it
fallback: retain all parents, original prior-mean and best deterministic image; unqualified posterior not treated as teacher or certified UQ
